### Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment Annual Benefit: R&D Savings: $58.6B {#sec-dfda_benefit_rd_only_annual}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual Decentralized Framework for Drug Assessment benefit from R&D savings (trial cost reduction, secondary component)

**Inputs**:

- [Annual Global Spending on Clinical Trials](#sec-global_clinical_trials_spending_annual) 📊: $60B (95% CI: $50B - $75B)
- [dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Percentage](#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_pct) 🔢: 97.7%

$$
\begin{gathered}
Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#cost-reduction](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#cost-reduction)

*✓ High confidence*

### dFDA Trial Cost Reduction Percentage: 97.7% {#sec-dfda_trial_cost_reduction_pct}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Trial cost reduction percentage: (traditional - dFDA) / traditional = ($41K - $1.2K) / $41K = 97%

**Inputs**:

- [dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient) 📊: $929 (95% CI: $97 - $3K)
- [Phase 3 Cost per Patient](#sec-traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient) 📊: $41K (95% CI: $20K - $120K)

$$
\begin{gathered}
Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#cost-reduction](../appendix/dfda-impact-paper#cost-reduction)

*✓ High confidence*

### Total Annual Cost of War Worldwide: $11.4T {#sec-global_annual_direct_indirect_war_cost}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Total annual cost of war worldwide (direct + indirect costs)

**Inputs**:

- [Total Annual Direct War Costs](#sec-global_annual_war_direct_costs_total) 🔢: $7.66T
- [Total Annual Indirect War Costs](#sec-global_annual_war_indirect_costs_total) 🔢: $3.70T

$$
\begin{gathered}
Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../problem/cost-of-war#total-cost](../problem/cost-of-war#total-cost)

*✓ High confidence*

$$

\text{where } Benefit_{peace+RD} \\
= Benefit_{peace,soc} + Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= \$114B + \$58.6B \\
= \$172B \\[0.5em]

= Cost_{war,total} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$11.4T \times 1\% \\
= \$114B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\

+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\

\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\

### Annual Peace Dividend from 1% Reduction in Total War Costs: $114B {#sec-peace_dividend_annual_societal_benefit}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Annual peace dividend from 1% reduction in total war costs

**Inputs**:

- [Total Annual Cost of War Worldwide](#sec-global_annual_direct_indirect_war_cost) 🔢: $11.4T
- [1% Reduction in Military Spending/War Costs from Treaty](#sec-treaty_reduction_pct): 1%

$$
\begin{gathered}
Benefit_{peace,soc} \\
= Cost_{war,total} \times Reduce_{treaty} \\
= \$11.4T \times 1\% \\
= \$114B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,total} \\
= Cost_{war,direct} + Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= \$7.66T + \$3.7T \\
= \$11.4T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T
\end{gathered}
$$

**Methodology**: [../appendix/peace-dividend-calculations](../appendix/peace-dividend-calculations)

*✓ High confidence*

\text{where } Cost_{war,direct} \\
= Loss_{life,conflict} + Damage_{infra,total} \\
+ Disruption_{trade} + Spending_{mil} \\
= \$2.45T + \$1.88T + \$616B + \$2.72T \\
= \$7.66T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Loss_{life,conflict} \\
= Cost_{combat,human} + Cost_{state,human} \\
+ Cost_{terror,human} \\
= \$2.34T + \$27B + \$83B \\
= \$2.45T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{combat,human} \\
= Deaths_{combat} \times VSL \\
= 234{,}000 \times \$10M \\
= \$2.34T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{state,human} \\
= Deaths_{state} \times VSL \\
= 2{,}700 \times \$10M \\
= \$27B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{terror,human} \\
= Deaths_{terror} \times VSL \\
= 8{,}300 \times \$10M \\
= \$83B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Damage_{infra,total} \\
= Damage_{comms} + Damage_{edu} + Damage_{energy} \\
+ Damage_{health} + Damage_{transport} \\
+ Damage_{water} \\
= \$298B + \$234B + \$422B + \$166B + \$487B + \$268B \\
= \$1.88T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Disruption_{trade} \\
= Disruption_{currency} + Disruption_{energy} \\
+ Disruption_{shipping} + Disruption_{supply} \\
= \$57.4B + \$125B + \$247B + \$187B \\
= \$616B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Cost_{war,indirect} \\
= Damage_{env} + Loss_{growth,mil} \\
+ Loss_{capital,conflict} + Cost_{psych} \\
+ Cost_{refugee} + Cost_{vet} \\
= \$100B + \$2.72T + \$300B + \$232B + \$150B + \$200B \\
= \$3.7T \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Benefit_{RD,ann} \\
= Spending_{trials} \times Reduce_{pct} \\
= \$60B \times 97.7\% \\
= \$58.6B \\[0.5em]
\text{where } Reduce_{pct} \\
= 1 - \frac{Cost_{pragmatic,pt}}{Cost_{P3,pt}} \\
= 1 - \frac{\$929}{\$41K} \\
= 97.7\%
\end{gathered}
$$

### dFDA Pragmatic Trial Cost per Patient: $929 {#sec-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

dFDA pragmatic trial cost per patient. Uses ADAPTABLE trial ($929) as DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE central estimate. Harvard meta-analysis of 108 trials found median of only $97/patient - our estimate may overstate costs by 10x. Confidence interval spans meta-analysis median to complex chronic disease trials.

**Source**: [NIH Common Fund (2025) - NIH Pragmatic Trials: Minimal Funding Despite 30x Cost Advantage](../references.qmd#pragmatic-trials-cost-advantage)

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$97, $3K] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between $97 and $3K (±156%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The lognormal distribution means values can't go negative and have a longer tail toward higher values (common for costs and populations).*

#### Input Distribution

{{< include ../figures/distribution-dfda_pragmatic_trial_cost_per_patient.qmd >}}

### Political Lobbying Campaign: Direct Lobbying, Super Pacs, Opposition Research, Staff, Legal/Compliance: $650M {#sec-treaty_campaign_budget_lobbying}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Political lobbying campaign: direct lobbying (US/EU/G20), Super PACs, opposition research, staff, legal/compliance. Budget exceeds combined pharma ($300M/year) and military-industrial complex ($150M/year) lobbying to ensure competitive positioning. Referendum relies on grassroots mobilization and earned media, while lobbying requires matching or exceeding opposition spending for political viability.

#### Uncertainty Range

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between $325M and $1.30B (±75%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

### Reserve Fund / Contingency Buffer: $100M {#sec-treaty_campaign_budget_reserve}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Reserve fund / contingency buffer (10% of total campaign cost). Using industry standard 10% for complex campaigns with potential for unforeseen legal challenges, opposition response, or regulatory delays. Conservative lower bound of $20M (2%) reflects transparent budget allocation and predictable referendum/lobbying costs.

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$20M, $150M] • Distribution: Lognormal

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between $20M and $150M (±65%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*The lognormal distribution means values can't go negative and have a longer tail toward higher values (common for costs and populations).*

*Core definition*

:::

### Viral Referendum Budget: $250M {#sec-treaty_campaign_viral_referendum_base_case}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="📊 Details"}

Viral referendum budget for 280M verified votes (base: $250M realistic with $0.50/vote avg, range: $150M optimistic $0.20/vote to $410M worst-case $1.05/vote). Components: platform ($35M), verification infrastructure (280M × friction × $0.18-0.20), tiered referral payments (varies by virality and marginal cost curve per diffusion theory), marketing seed ($5-15M). Based on PayPal referral economics ($18-36 inflation-adjusted) and biometric verification pricing ($0.15-0.25 at 300M+ scale).

#### Uncertainty Range

**Technical**: 95% CI: [$150M, $410M]

**What this means**: This estimate is highly uncertain. The true value likely falls between $150M and $410M (±52%). This represents a very wide range that our Monte Carlo simulations account for when calculating overall uncertainty in the results.

*Core definition*

:::

```{=html}
<script>
// Conservative lazy loading: only load images actually in viewport
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  let imageObserver = null;
  let loadTimeout = null;
  
  function enableLazyLoading() {
    const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');
    
    // Use Intersection Observer with conservative threshold
    // rootMargin: '50px' means only load images within 50px of viewport
    // This prevents loading images passed through during hash navigation
    imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0) {
          const img = entry.target;
          // Only load if image is actually visible (not just passed through)
          if (img.dataset.src) {
            img.src = img.dataset.src;
            img.removeAttribute('data-src');
          } else if (!img.hasAttribute('loading')) {
            // For images without data-src, use native lazy loading
            img.setAttribute('loading', 'lazy');
          }
          observer.unobserve(img);
        }
      });
    }, {
      rootMargin: '50px',  // Only load images within 50px of viewport
      threshold: 0.01      // Trigger when at least 1% visible
    });
    
    images.forEach(img => {
      imageObserver.observe(img);
    });
  }
  
  // Handle hash navigation (clicking links to sections)
  // Delay loading to avoid loading images passed through during jump
  function handleHashNavigation() {
    if (loadTimeout) clearTimeout(loadTimeout);
    // Wait 300ms after navigation to let scroll settle
    // Images will load naturally via Intersection Observer when visible
    loadTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      // Scroll has settled, Intersection Observer will handle visible images
      // No action needed - observer is already watching
    }, 300);
  }
  
  // Initialize on page load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', enableLazyLoading);
  } else {
    enableLazyLoading();
  }
  
  // Handle hash changes (clicking anchor links)
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashNavigation);
  
  // Also handle initial hash if page loads with one
  if (window.location.hash) {
    setTimeout(handleHashNavigation, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
```
